rationale: Builds on the 0031 recurrent-tail baseline but reallocates the fp16 export budget toward the matrices traversed twice in reverse-tail recurrence. The recurrent tail now keeps q/k/v/attn.proj in fp16, while non-recurrent tail proj retention is trimmed and only the final mlp.proj stays fp16. This is a compact export-path change aimed directly at final int8+zlib roundtrip bpb, not training loss.
title: Recurrent Attention FP16 Reallocation
